title: Joining Reinhardt's band at Jazz Limited

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: In 1959, you went with Bill Rinehart's (PHONETIC) band at Jazz Limited. How'd that come about?

Well, I was recommended by Franz Jackson. They were looking for a bass player for a New Year's Eve gig, and they wanted a tuba player, and they didn't know any other tuba players, so they wanted to get Franz Jackson's tuba player, and Franz Jackson said, "I don't lend my tuba player out to anybody. But I got a good one for you. So they recommended me. So I played the New Year's Eve gig for them, and then they hired me to come into Jazz Limited for six days.
Must have been New Year's Eve 1959.
'59. And then you started -- that would make it '60 when you started, or was it New Year's Eve '58?
I started, really, December '59. Must have been New Year's '60.
Okay. Had they been using tuba before then?
What'd he do, have string bass?
Was that at the old place, or --
11 East Grand. And who was in the band then?
Dave Raspberry (PHONETIC) on the trombone, what was his name, Joe ______ on the trumpet -- can't think of his name. Max Hooper on piano, Fred Kohlman on drums.
Freddie was still with the band then?
